description: Configure OneAgent options for Dynatrace Log Monitoring

LAConfigOpenLogFilesDetectionEnabled.description: Automatically detect logs written by important processes. For more details, check our [documentation](https://dt-url.net/7v02z76)

LAConfigSystemLogsDetectionEnabled.description: Linux: syslog, message log Windows: system, application, security event logs

LAConfigContainersLogsDetectionEnabled.description: Allows detection of log messages written to the containerized application's stdout/stderr streams.

LAConfigIISDetectionEnabled.description: Allows detection of logs and event logs written by IIS server.

LAConfigLogScannerLinuxNfsEnabled.displayName: Detect logs on network file systems
LAConfigLogScannerLinuxNfsEnabled.description: Allows detection of logs written to mounted network storage drives. Applies only to Linux hosts. For Windows operating system it's always enabled.

LAConfigMonitorOwnLogsEnabled.displayName: Allow OneAgent to monitor Dynatrace logs
LAConfigMonitorOwnLogsEnabled.description: Enabling this option may affect your licensing costs. For more details, see [documentation](https://dt-url.net/7v02z76).

LAConfigContainerTimezoneHeuristicEnable.description: Enables automatic detection of timezone in container's logs if it is not explicitly defined in content or configured.

LAConfigDefaultTimezone.description: Default timezone for agent if more specific configurations is not defined.

LAConfigDateSearchLimit_Bytes.description: Defines the number of characters in every log line (starting from the first character in the line) where the timestamp is searched.

LAConfigSeverityDetectionLimit_Bytes.description: Defines the number of characters in every log line (starting from the first character in the line) where severity is searched.

LAConfigSeverityDetectionLinesLimit.description: Defines the number of the first lines of every log entry where severity is searched.

LAConfigMaxLgisPerEntityCount.displayName: Maximum number of log sources per process group instance
LAConfigMaxLgisPerEntityCount.description: Defines the maximum number of log group instances per entity after which, the new automatic ones wouldn't be added.

LAConfigEventLogQueryTimeout_Sec.description: Defines the maximum timeout value, in seconds, for the query extracting Windows Event Logs

LAConfigMinBinaryDetectionLimit_Bytes.displayName: Minimal log file size to perform binary detection.
LAConfigMinBinaryDetectionLimit_Bytes.description: Defines the minimum number of bytes in log file required for binary detection.

BinaryDetectionMode.description: Specifies the granularity at which binary log files are detected. 'Per log source' applies binary detection at the log source level, 'Per log file' evaluates each log file individually.
